page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores and 80 vCPUs, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for data persistence and operating system deployment. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The lack of local storage and hardware acceleration represents a design tradeoff, focusing resources entirely on memory capacity and compute density.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per vCPU makes this instance type suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of GPU hardware. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy caching layers, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
